script:
repo.edit("src/limits.rs", "pub const LIMIT: u32 = 4;", "pub const LIMIT: u32 = 8;")
after = repo.read("src/limits.rs")
t = env.run(["cargo", "test"], check = False)
result = {
  "after_edit": after,
  "test_code": t.code,
  "test_out": t.stdout,
  "test_err": t.stderr,
}
if t.code != 0:
    repo.reset("src/limits.rs")
    result["kept"] = False
    result["reverted_to"] = repo.read("src/limits.rs")
else:
    result["kept"] = True
return result
